description: This file defines the `PhotoTask` class in Java, which manages photo download and decoding tasks for an Android application. It orchestrates runnable objects for download and decode operations, maintains references to UI components via weak references, handles threading, and interacts with a photo manager singleton. The class provides methods for task initialization, resource management, and state handling within the photo processing lifecycle.

classes.name: PhotoTask
classes.description: A class that manages the execution of photo download and decoding tasks, providing resource management, thread handling, and state communication within an Android photo processing context.

methods.name: PhotoTask
methods.description: Constructor that initializes runnable objects for download and decode operations, and initializes the photo manager singleton.

methods.name: initializeDownloaderTask
methods.description: Sets up the task with a photo manager, photo view, and caching preference, extracting the image URL and view dimensions.

methods.name: recycle
methods.description: Cleans up resources and references within the task, preparing it for reuse or disposal.

methods.name: getByteBuffer
methods.description: Returns the byte buffer containing image data.

methods.name: getTargetWidth
methods.description: Returns the target width for image decoding.

methods.name: getTargetHeight
methods.description: Returns the target height for image decoding.

methods.name: getImageURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the image being downloaded.

methods.name: setByteBuffer
methods.description: Sets the byte buffer with image data.

methods.name: handleState
methods.description: Delegates task state handling to the photo manager.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the decoded Bitmap image.

methods.name: getHTTPDownloadRunnable
methods.description: Returns the runnable responsible for downloading the image.

methods.name: getPhotoDecodeRunnable
methods.description: Returns the runnable responsible for decoding the image.

methods.name: getPhotoView
methods.description: Retrieves the PhotoView associated with this task if it still exists.

methods.name: getCurrentThread
methods.description: Returns the Thread on which this task is running, synchronized via the photo manager.

methods.name: setCurrentThread
methods.description: Sets the Thread on which this task is running, synchronized via the photo manager.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the decoded Bitmap image.

methods.name: setDownloadThread
methods.description: Assigns the current thread responsible for downloading.

methods.name: handleDownloadState
methods.description: Converts and forwards download state updates to the photo manager.

methods.name: setImageDecodeThread
methods.description: Assigns the current thread responsible for decoding.

methods.name: handleDecodeState
methods.description: Converts and forwards decode state updates to the photo manager.
